status: declared by the pull request that closes #480 before any diagnostic was computed; reported only, nothing here changes the bar, the judge's declaration, a model or any published figure; the choices below are the pull request's, listed there for Eleonora's review

training_history.reading: the refit in force at each episode is the judge's: refits every 21 scored days from the first scored day (metadata/pressure_judge.json, cutoff_rule); the model is fitted on the panel from its first day to the refit's training end, the business day h + 1 before the block's first day; shown at h = 1 and at h = 5
training_history.cutoff_reading: the flag cut-off in force is chosen on the scored days of the training window (select_cutoff); a window with no onset never flags

target.technical_adjustment_rule: an IOER/IORB change in the panel whose size is not a multiple of 25 bp is read as a technical adjustment relative to the target range (the range itself is not in the tracked data); the 2021-07-29 IOER to IORB renaming (no change in level) is listed apart

episode_sensitivity.rule: an onset is a scored day above the threshold (whole basis points, strictly) with no day above it in the calm_days panel days before it; the episodes of the grid are compared with the primary (+5 bp, 5 calm days) by date

checks.gap: a weekday in the window that is neither a panel day nor a day in metadata/market_holidays.json
checks.blank: a window row whose cell is empty
checks.repeat: a daily column whose value equals the previous panel day's (a forward fill reads like this); a weekly column is judged by the panel days since its value last changed, flagged above 7 calendar days
checks.revision: for reserve_balances, tga and the IOER/IORB level: the first tracked ALFRED vintage that holds the observation against the latest tracked vintage; other fields have no tracked vintages and are not checked
checks.late_publication: not checked beyond what the as-of rule already does: the panel is point-in-time, so a late publication shows as a stale or repeated value

data_integrity.blinding_rule: a window is flagged as one that would blind a model when the decision-day row has a blank or a gap in sofr or iorb, or a weekly column more than 7 calendar days old, or the previous panel day is missing

benchmarks_by_year.rows_note: the five tier-1 passers of the unweighted rule are the five risk-date severity rows (docs/pivot/weighted-miss-result.md, Table 1); the two benchmarks are the judge's
benchmarks_by_year.flags: the judge's own: a probability at or above the cut-off chosen refit by refit from the training window (pressure_judge.choose_cutoffs), at +5 bp, at each horizon h = 1 to 5; an episode is warned when some horizon flags it
